title: publicRoutes rate limit per address
drive: From one address, 40 POST /ping in under a minute: the first 30 answer 200, the next 10 answer 429 without running the plugin.

Same 40 again, each with a different X-Forwarded-For: still 429 after 30, unless the server trusts a proxy (then the limit applies to the address the proxy gives, and the test sets trust proxy explicitly).
GET /count, called from a second address, answers {"n": 30}: the 10 refused requests never ran the plugin.
